Test Case Name: Verify eligible CDSPI COC and CGL product availability
Description: Validate that applicable product options are available for an eligible transaction
Action: 1. Start a new policy transaction; 2. Enter an eligible applicant; 3. Select an eligible jurisdiction and transaction type [TBD]; 4. Open product selection
Expected Result: The applicable CDSPI COC and CGL options are displayed and available
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Product Availability

Test Case Name: Start CDSPI COC and CGL transaction
Description: Validate that the user can initiate the applicable workflow
Action: 1. Select the CDSPI COC and CGL product; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The COC and CGL workflow opens with the required sections displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Product Availability

Description: Validate acceptance of valid COC status completion date project description and limits
Action: 1. Open the COC section; 2. Select a valid COC status [TBD]; 3. Enter a valid completion date; 4. Enter a valid project or risk description; 5. Enter valid historical COC limits
Expected Result: All valid COC values are accepted without validation errors
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Information

Description: Validate that a required supporting COC document can be attached
Action: 1. Open the COC document control; 2. Select a valid supported document [TBD]; 3. Upload the document
Expected Result: The document uploads successfully and is associated with the COC information
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Documents

Description: Validate acceptance of applicant business operations location exposures and claims information
Action: 1. Enter valid applicant and business information; 2. Enter valid operations and location; 3. Enter valid exposure values; 4. Complete claims history information
Expected Result: The CGL risk information is accepted and saved
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/CGL Risk Information

Description: Validate selection of configured CGL coverage options
Action: 1. Open CGL coverage options; 2. Select a permitted coverage [TBD]; 3. Select an allowed limit and deductible
Expected Result: The selected coverage limit and deductible are displayed and accepted
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Coverage Selection

Test Case Name: Select permitted extension exclusion or endorsement
Description: Validate that configured optional CGL selections can be applied
Action: 1. Open extensions exclusions or endorsements; 2. Select a permitted option [TBD]; 3. Complete any dependent fields
Expected Result: The selection is applied and dependent fields appear when configured
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Optional Coverage

Test Case Name: Save completed COC and CGL information
Description: Validate persistence of a completed transaction
Action: 1. Complete valid COC and CGL information; 2. Click Save; 3. Navigate away; 4. Reopen the transaction
Expected Result: All saved COC values and CGL selections are retained
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Save

Description: Validate premium calculation from valid COC CGL and exposure inputs
Action: 1. Complete valid COC and CGL data; 2. Select permitted coverage; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The system calculates and displays the configured CGL premium applicable charges and total
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Rating

Test Case Name: Complete approved bind and issue workflow
Description: Validate policy completion after all validations and approvals pass
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Complete required approvals; 4. Bind and issue
Expected Result: The policy is bound and issued with the correct status COC details and CGL selections
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Policy Workflow

Description: Validate product eligibility behavior for an ineligible risk
Action: 1. Start a new transaction; 2. Enter an ineligible applicant operation or jurisdiction [TBD]; 3. Open product selection
Expected Result: The product is unavailable or the configured eligibility message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Eligibility

Description: Validate required-field behavior for COC status
Action: 1. Open an eligible transaction; 2. Leave COC status empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A field-level validation message is displayed and progression is blocked
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Validation

Description: Validate required-field behavior for COC completion date
Action: 1. Complete other COC fields; 2. Leave completion date empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The completion-date field is flagged and progression is blocked
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Validation

Description: Validate configured COC date rules
Action: 1. Enter a disallowed or invalid completion date [TBD]; 2. Complete the remaining COC fields; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The date is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Validation

Description: Validate required-field behavior for the project or risk description
Action: 1. Enter valid COC status and date; 2. Leave project or risk description empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The description field is flagged and progression is blocked
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Validation

Description: Validate document requirement behavior when supporting evidence is mandatory
Action: 1. Complete COC fields; 2. Do not upload the required supporting document; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The document requirement is displayed and progression is blocked
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/COC Documents

Description: Validate that incomplete CGL information blocks progression
Action: 1. Leave one or more required CGL fields empty; 2. Click Continue or Quote
Expected Result: Field-level validation messages identify missing information and the workflow does not proceed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/CGL Validation

Description: Validate configured exposure validation rules
Action: 1. Enter an invalid or out-of-range exposure value [TBD]; 2. Click Continue or Quote
Expected Result: The exposure value is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/CGL Validation

Test Case Name: Reject unavailable CGL coverage limit or deductible
Description: Validate that unconfigured coverage values cannot be submitted
Action: 1. Attempt to select an unavailable limit or deductible [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The invalid selection cannot be submitted and a validation message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Coverage Validation

Description: Validate that quoting is blocked when required COC or CGL data is incomplete
Action: 1. Complete only part of the COC and CGL information; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: The system identifies incomplete data and does not complete the quote
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Quote Validation

Test Case Name: Create underwriting referral for qualifying COC or CGL risk
Description: Validate configured referral behavior
Action: 1. Enter historical COC or CGL information that meets a referral rule [TBD]; 2. Click Quote or Bind
Expected Result: The system creates the configured referral displays its status and prevents completion
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Underwriting Referral

Description: Validate that an unresolved underwriting referral blocks binding
Action: 1. Create a qualifying referral; 2. Do not resolve the referral; 3. Click Bind
Expected Result: Binding is blocked and the required referral action is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Underwriting Referral

Description: Validate the configured minimum historical COC limit
Action: 1. Enter the minimum valid COC limit [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The minimum valid limit is accepted
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Boundary

Description: Validate lower-bound behavior for historical COC limits
Action: 1. Enter a COC limit below the configured minimum [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The value is rejected and a range validation message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Boundary

Description: Validate the configured maximum CGL exposure boundary
Action: 1. Enter the maximum valid exposure [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The maximum valid exposure is accepted and rating can proceed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Boundary

Description: Validate upper-bound behavior for CGL exposure
Action: 1. Enter an exposure above the configured maximum [TBD]; 2. Click Continue or Quote
Expected Result: The value is rejected and a range validation message is displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Boundary

Description: Validate that dependent COC fields appear for configured COC statuses
Action: 1. Select a COC status that requires additional information [TBD]; 2. Observe the form
Expected Result: The dependent fields or document controls appear and are marked required when configured
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Conditional Fields

Description: Validate dependent-field behavior when the triggering answer changes
Action: 1. Trigger a conditional COC field; 2. Enter a value; 3. Change the status so the field is not applicable
Expected Result: The field is hidden or disabled and its value is cleared or ignored according to configuration
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Conditional Fields

Description: Validate recovery after correcting invalid COC or CGL information
Action: 1. Submit incomplete or invalid data; 2. Correct each highlighted field; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: Validation messages clear and the workflow proceeds successfully
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Error Recovery

Test Case Name: Edit saved COC and CGL transaction
Description: Validate that saved information can be updated
Action: 1. Open a saved transaction; 2. Change a COC or CGL value; 3. Save; 4. Reopen the transaction
Expected Result: The changed value is saved and displayed in the relevant section
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Workflow

Description: Validate document attachment based on coverage jurisdiction transaction and effective date
Action: 1. Complete valid COC and CGL data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Open the document list
Expected Result: Required COC and CGL forms attachments and disclosures are present with the correct version and effective date
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Documents

Description: Validate document generation when the policy is issued
Action: 1. Complete validations and approvals; 2. Issue the policy; 3. Open generated documents
Expected Result: Required issued-policy documents are generated and correct form editions are displayed
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Documents

Test Case Name: Verify COC and CGL audit history
Description: Validate retention of historical values changes rating inputs referrals approvals and documents
Action: 1. Save a transaction; 2. Change a COC or CGL value; 3. Create and resolve a referral; 4. Open transaction history
Expected Result: The audit history displays relevant values changes referrals approvals rating inputs and documents
Test Repository Path: CDSPI Historical COC and CGL/Audit History
